name: cc-grammar-coach
description: Out-of-band English grammar checker (UserPromptSubmit hook) that logs your mistakes and shows statusline feedback, plus drill, learn and progress skills that teach from the log inside the session. After installing, run /cc-grammar-coach:configure install-statusline once to wire the feedback into your statusline.

native_language.title: Native language
native_language.description: Your native language, used by the drill, learn and progress skills to explain English grammar with contrasts you will recognize. Leave empty for generic, language-neutral lessons.

rephrase.title: Suggest rephrasings
rephrase.description: When enabled, the checker may append a single more-natural rewrite of the whole message when it is clearly awkward. Grammar flags are shown regardless of this setting.

llm_base_url.title: LLM base URL
llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint base URL for the checker. Required: the checker stays inactive until the base URL, model, and API key are all set.

llm_model.title: LLM model
llm_model.description: Model identifier passed to the checker endpoint.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: API key for the checker endpoint. Stored outside settings.json and injected into the hook environment only.
